entities.name: Opal-Eye
entities.description: Kitsune samurai yojimbo of Kamigawa, bodyguard to Takeshi Konda in the Kami War; presumed deceased.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Daimyo protected by Opal-Eye; defeated at the end of the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Opal-Eye was active.

events.summary: Opal-Eye is presumed deceased after the end of the Kami War and Konda's defeat.
events.quote: He is presumed deceased following the end of the Kami War

relations.note: He was one of Konda's personal protectors.
